Create a new SystemVerilog IP block for the FPGA Cores 4 U digital IP library.

## 1. Identity

- Module name: `symbol_overlay_top` (IP directory `symbol_overlay`)
- Library category: `video`
- Location: `ip/video/symbol_overlay/`
- One-line purpose: Symbol overlay for an AXI4-Stream video (24-bit pixels, tuser = start of frame, tlast = end of line).
- Version: 1.0.0

## 2. Context

- Where it is used: `video_processor`.
- Existing IP to reuse (do not duplicate):

| Module | From | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `axil_if` | `shared/src` | AXI4-Lite interface of the FPGA Cores 4 U library, the common definition every block's register-bus ports follow. |
| `axis_if` | `shared/src` | AXI4-Stream interface of the FPGA Cores 4 U library, the common definition every block's stream ports follow. |
| `regbus_if` | `shared/src` | Simple register bus between an AXI4-Lite front end (axi4_lite_slave, axil_regbus) and the register block: one-clock write / read strobes, error answers that become SLVERR. |
| `axi4_lite_slave` | `axi4_lite_slave` | Generic AXI4-Lite slave front end. |

## 3. Parameters

| Name | Default | Meaning / legal range |

| `NOBJ` | `4` | - |

Reject illegal values at elaboration with `$error` inside a generate block.

## 4. Clocks, resets and clock-domain crossings

- Clocks: `clk`.
- Resets: `rst_n`.
- Clock and reset behaviour, and any clock-domain crossing, as described in section 6.
- Every clock domain: name, frequency, source, the logic on it. Every reset: one per domain, synchronous active low inside the domain, entering the domain only through a reset synchroniser (asynchronous assertion, synchronous release); reset sequencing between domains has a single, documented source.
- Every clock, reset and signal boundary uses a clock-domain crossing technique, listed in the file header. Never sample another domain's signal directly; never pass a multi-bit value through independent single-bit synchronisers. Example techniques:

| Technique | Use for | Library module |
|-----------|---------|----------------|
| Two- (or more) flop synchroniser (`async_reg`) | single slow level signal (enable, status, IRQ level) | `bit_sync` |
| Pulse synchroniser (toggle, sync, edge detect) | one-clock event / pulse | `pulse_sync`, `toggle_sync` |
| Reset synchroniser (async assert, sync release) | a reset entering a clock domain | `reset_sync`, `reset_ctrl` |
| Asynchronous FIFO with Gray-coded pointers | data stream at any rate ratio | `async_fifo`, `axis_async_bridge` |
| Request / acknowledge handshake (2- or 4-phase) | occasional multi-bit word, register access | `axi4_lite_cdc`, `clock_domain_bridge` |
| Multi-cycle path formulation (hold data, sync a qualifier) | multi-bit value that changes rarely | `cdc_sync_bit` + held register |
| Gray-code counter | counter value read in another domain | inside `async_fifo` |
| Glitch-free clock gate / mux | stopping or switching a clock | device BUFGCE / BUFGMUX, `clk_gen` enables |
| Related clocks from one PLL (fixed phase) | serializers, e.g. 10:1 TMDS, 7:1 LVDS | `clk_gen` outputs of one oscillator |

- Constrain every crossing (false path / max delay on the synchroniser's first flop) and document it.

## 5. Interfaces

| Port | Dir | Width | Group | Built when | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clk` | input | 1 | - | - | - |
| `rst_n` | input | 1 | - | - | - |

Back-pressure on every stream: honour tready, never drop data unless section 6 says so; valid must not depend combinationally on ready.

AXI4-Lite / register map: as listed in the behaviour text in section 6. Out-of-range accesses return SLVERR (or DECERR where stated).

## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference design's specification):

```text
Symbol overlay for an AXI4-Stream video (24-bit pixels,
tuser = start of frame, tlast = end of line). Version 2.0.0 (the VERSION
register). Draws, as the video streams through (no frame buffer), up to
NOBJ objects (each a symbol and a label of up to 4 characters) and NTXT
texts. Golden model: ip/video/symbol_overlay/model/symbol_overlay_model.py
(its header is the full definition of every symbol, label and text;
the output frames are bit exact, tb/python).
Layers of a pixel: the symbol of the lowest-index enabled object that
covers it (its colour, or with BLEND the 50 % mix with the video), then
the label of the lowest-index object whose label cells cover it
(backdrop: the pixel halved, then the glyph), then the text of lowest
index covering it (halved with BACKDROP, then the glyph). Symbols:
rectangle outline (dashed, solid CORNERS, TICKS), filled box,
crosshair, circle / oval (an exact integer ellipse ring in doubled
coordinates), triangle (TRIANGLE: integer edges, dashed with solid
vertices). Glyphs: the 3 x 5 font (overlay_font_pkg) at 1x / 2x / 4x /
8x, or with CTRL.FONT at 2x and larger the smooth font (4-bit coverage
ROMs overlay_font_aa_s<S>.mem in FONT_DIR: v = (v (15 - a) + c a + 7) /
15). Texts may end with the frame number (5 BCD digits).
Updates: the CPU writes registers in any order, then COMMIT; the next
frame start takes a snapshot of every object / text register and CTRL's
LABEL_SCALE / FONT (STATUS[0] pending until then; a COMMIT in the clock
of the snapshot waits for the following frame). CTRL.ENABLE is taken at
every frame start (clear: the video passes unchanged). FRAME_NUM: a
write sets the number of the next frame, otherwise each frame start
adds one (BCD); reads return the current frame's number.
Labels are placed with the size of the frame before the commit is
applied (2**CW - 1 before the first frame): centred under the symbol
inb the frame width, above the symbol when they would crs the
frame's bottom.
Timing: at a frame start the stream is held (s_axis.tready low) until
the pipeline has drained, the snapshot is prepared (2 clocks) and row 0
is computed (the row engine symbol_overlay_rows, about 4 NOBJ + 3 CW + 7
clocks); the next row is computed while a row streams, and the first
beat of a row waits one clock to take it (or longer when a row is
shorter than the row engine's time). Pipeline latency 4 clocks, full
back-pressure. The output pixels do not depend on the timing.
Limits: frame width and height below 2**CW; coordinates are CW bits.
Registers on the cfg_* / sts_* ports; symbol_overlay_top.sv is the block
with its AXI4-Lite register map (src/include/symbol_overlay_regs.sv,
ADDR_W = 10): ID "SOVL" / VERSION / DATE at 0x00-0x08, CTRL 0x18, COMMIT
0x1C, STATUS 0x20, FRAME_NUM 0x24, objects 0-15 OBJ_CTRL / OBJ_X / OBJ_Y
/ OBJ_COLOR at 0x50 + 16 i, OBJ_LABEL at 0x260 + 4 i, objects 16-31 at
0x2A0 + 16 (i - 16) and their labels at 0x3A0 + 4 (i - 16), texts j
TXT_CTRL / TXT_POS / TXT_COLOR at 0x150 + 16 j, TXT_CHARS at 0x210 + 16 j.
Clock - clk (pixel clock). Reset - synchronous active low rst_n.

symbol_overlay with its AXI4-Lite register interface, the
block designs and testbenches instantiate: the register map
symbol_overlay_regs (u_regs, src/include/symbol_overlay_regs.sv, ID
"SOVL", VERSION and DATE at 0x00-0x08, the registers from 0x10) and the
logic symbol_overlay (u_core, src/symbol_overlay.sv), joined by the
register interface symbol_overlay_regs_if (u_regs_if). Generated by
ip/scripts/regmap_gen.py from symbol_overlay_regs.json and the ports of
symbol_overlay: regenerate after changing either. Clock - clk. Reset -
synchronous active low rst_n.
```

Describe and handle the edge cases, error recovery, latency and configuration-change rules stated above; where the text is silent, choose the safe option and document it in the file header.

## 6a. Industry reference check

Comparison of section 6 with published engineering references. Every difference is a `TODO(REF-...)` written as a prompt for updating the design.

```text
// Industry reference check - symbol_overlay (2026-10-16)
// Sources:
//   [1] T. Porter, T. Duff, "Compositing Digital Images", SIGGRAPH 1984,
//   https://graphics.pixar.com/library/Compositing (over: c = a cA + (1 - a) cB)
// Published algorithm / equations:
//   Compositing: over operator c = a * c_fg + (1 - a) * c_bg (Porter & Duff 1984); 50 % blend =
//   (fg + bg) / 2. Shapes by implicit tests (circle dx^2 + dy^2 <= R^2, ellipse dx^2 B^2 + dy^2
//   A^2 <= A^2 B^2).
// Comparison with this IP (section 6):
//   Matches: opaque or a = 0.5 over, implicit circle / ellipse tests, z-order (object 0 on
//   top), frame-synchronous commit.
// Result: in line with the reference; no TODO.
```

### Register map (from `symbol_overlay_regs.json`)

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description | Fields |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | ID | RO | "SOVL" | IP identifier, 4 ASCII characters (first in [31:24]) | - |
| 0x04 | VERSION | RO | - | version, ASCII "d.dd" (+0.01 at every source update) | - |
| 0x08 | DATE | RO | - | date of the last source update, BCD mm/dd/yyyy | - |
| 0x18 | CTRL | RW | 0 | [0] enable (taken at every frame start), [2:1] LABEL_SCALE (taken with a COMMIT, as FONT): object labels drawn at 1 << LABEL_SCALE times the 3 x 5 font's cell (0 = 1x), [3] FONT: labels and texts at 2x, 4x, 8x in the smooth font (DejaVu Sans Mono Bold, 4-bit coverage blended with the video; src/include/overlay_font_aa_s<S>.mem from scripts/make_aa_font.py) instead of the enlarged 3 x 5 font (1x is always the 3 x 5 font) | - |
| 0x1C | COMMIT | CMD | 0 | write 1: the object and text registers apply at the next frame start; reads [0] commit pending | - |
| 0x20 | STATUS | RO | 0 | state | PENDING[0] commit pending; FRAMES[31:16] frames (low 16 bits) |
| 0x24 | FRAME_NUM | CMD | 0 | write: the number (5 BCD digits) the next frame shows, then one more per frame; read: the last frame's | - |
| 0x50 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? 16 : NOBJ)) | OBJ_CTRL | RW | 0 | object i: symbol and style | EN[0] enable; SHAPE[2:1] 0 rectangle outline, 1 filled, 2 crosshair, 3 circle (round the box centre, diameter the larger side); DASHED[3] dashed; BLEND[4] 50 % blend with the video; OVAL[5] shape 3: an oval (ellipse) inside the box instead of the circle; TICKS[6] rectangle: a 2-pixel tick at the middle of each side, pointing to the centre; TRIANGLE[7] an upward triangle inscribed in the box (any SHAPE): dashed edges with DASHED, the vertices solid; LINE_W[11:8] line width (0 = 1); DASH_LOG2[14:12] dash length log2; CORNERS[15] dashed rectangle: the corners (a quarter of the shorter side, at least 3 pixels) solid |
| 0x54 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? 16 : NOBJ)) | OBJ_X | RW | 0 | object i columns: [15:0] x0 [31:16] x1 | - |
| 0x58 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? 16 : NOBJ)) | OBJ_Y | RW | 0 | object i lines: [15:0] y0 [31:16] y1 | - |
| 0x5C + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? 16 : NOBJ)) | OBJ_COLOR | RW | 0 | object i colour, pixel as on the stream ([7:0] R [15:8] G [23:16] B) | - |
| 0x150 + 16 i (i < (NTXT < 1 ? 1 : NTXT)) | TXT_CTRL | RW | 0 | text j | EN[0] enable; SCALE[2:1] scale log2 (0-3: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x); BACKDROP[3] darken the video under the text; FNUM[4] the frame number after the characters; LENGTH[12:8] characters (0-16) |
| 0x154 + 16 i (i < (NTXT < 1 ? 1 : NTXT)) | TXT_POS | RW | 0 | text j top-left corner: [15:0] x [31:16] y | - |
| 0x158 + 16 i (i < (NTXT < 1 ? 1 : NTXT)) | TXT_COLOR | RW | 0 | text j colour, pixel as on the stream | - |
| 0x210 + 4 i (i < 4 * (NTXT < 1 ? 1 : NTXT)) | TXT_CHARS | RW | 0 | characters: word 4 j + q of text j holds characters 4 q .. 4 q + 3 (ASCII, character 4 q in [7:0]) | - |
| 0x260 + 4 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? 16 : NOBJ)) | OBJ_LABEL | RW | 0 | object i label: up to 4 ASCII characters (character 0 in [7:0], 0 ends it), drawn at 1 << CTRL.LABEL_SCALE times the font, centred below the symbol (above it when it would cross the bottom of the frame) on a darkened backdrop | - |
| 0x2A0 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? NOBJ - 16 : 1)) | OBJ2_CTRL | RW | 0 | second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_CTRL (NOBJ above 16) | EN[0] enable; SHAPE[2:1] 0 rectangle outline, 1 filled, 2 crosshair, 3 circle (round the box centre, diameter the larger side); DASHED[3] dashed; BLEND[4] 50 % blend with the video; OVAL[5] shape 3: an oval (ellipse) inside the box instead of the circle; TICKS[6] rectangle: a 2-pixel tick at the middle of each side, pointing to the centre; TRIANGLE[7] an upward triangle inscribed in the box (any SHAPE): dashed edges with DASHED, the vertices solid; LINE_W[11:8] line width (0 = 1); DASH_LOG2[14:12] dash length log2; CORNERS[15] dashed rectangle: the corners (a quarter of the shorter side, at least 3 pixels) solid |
| 0x2A4 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? NOBJ - 16 : 1)) | OBJ2_X | RW | 0 | second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_X (NOBJ above 16) | - |
| 0x2A8 + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? NOBJ - 16 : 1)) | OBJ2_Y | RW | 0 | second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_Y (NOBJ above 16) | - |
| 0x2AC + 16 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? NOBJ - 16 : 1)) | OBJ2_COLOR | RW | 0 | second bank: object 16 + i, as OBJ_COLOR (NOBJ above 16) | - |
| 0x3A0 + 4 i (i < (NOBJ > 16 ? NOBJ - 16 : 1)) | OBJ2_LABEL | RW | 0 | second bank: label of object 16 + i, as OBJ_LABEL (NOBJ above 16) | - |

## 7. Implementation constraints

- Synthesizable SystemVerilog-2012, technology independent (no vendor primitives; infer RAM and DSP).
- Must work in iverilog 12+ (`-g2012`), Verilator lint (`-Wall`, no UNOPTFLAT or latches) and Yosys (through sv2v: add the `scripts/sv2v` marker file).
- iverilog limits: declare before use; no enum ternaries without casts; no `break`; no arrays of queues; no `wait` on function calls; no declarations inside nested loop bodies of static initial blocks.
- No combinational path from a ready input back to a ready output; hoist scratch variables (no latches); split control and data `always_ff` blocks.
- One statement per line (`a <= b; c <= d;` is two lines; `if (x) y <= 1; else y <= 0;` is four).
- Instantiations: one parameter per line in `#( ... )` and one port per line, closing with `) u_name (` and `);` at the instance's indentation; a port-group macro is one port on its own line.
- Check with `python3 ip/scripts/sv_format.py --check <files>` (it can also rewrite: whitespace only, token-checked).
- Resources: Last Yosys synth_xilinx (7-series) result: about 13078 LUTs, 8515 flip-flops, 8 DSP48E1, 23 RAMB36E1. Stay within about this budget.

## 9. Guidelines

Follow the design guidelines in `ip/docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md` (complete rules; this prompt wins where it sets a value explicitly). In short:

- Synthesizable, technology-independent SystemVerilog-2012; behavioural models behind `` `ifdef SYNTHESIS `` black boxes; iverilog / Verilator / Yosys clean.
- Layout: one statement per line; one parameter and one port per line in instantiations; two-space indent; a comment on every port.
- Naming: `lower_snake_case` modules and files, `u_` instances, `g_` generate blocks, `UPPER_CASE` parameters, `_i` / `_o` / `_n` / `_t` port suffixes, `s_axis_` / `m_axis_` / `s_axil_` buses.
- Clocks and resets per domain, every crossing through a CDC technique (see the clocks section).
- AXI4-Stream data with back-pressure, AXI4-Lite control (ID / INFO registers, SLVERR out of range), defined switch-over points for configuration changes.
- Self-checking testbench with an independent model, named `test_<what>` tasks in `tb/tests/<name>_tests.sv`, gaps and back-pressure, a mutation check, 100 % code coverage.
- Diagrams: module and instance names, arrows from output to input, no crossing lines, every clock and reset domain labelled.

Guidelines file: `ip/docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md`   (replace with your own guidelines file if needed)

## 12. Verification requirements

The reference testbench checks the following; the new testbench must cover at least the same:

```text
Self-checking testbench for symbol_overlay (NOBJ = 4, 24-bit
pixels): the structural checks (ID block, registers, pass-through with
gaps and back-pressure, COMMIT / STATUS / ENABLE timing with a filled
box, FRAME_NUM). Frames are driven and monitored by axis_frame_bfm. Every
pixel of every symbol, label and text is compared with the golden model
by the cocotb test tb/python/symbol_overlay_tb.py. Prints TEST PASSED on
success; +vcd dumps symbol_overlay_tb.vcd. The test tasks are in
tests/symbol_overlay_tests.sv (`included).
```

There is also a Python (cocotb) test in `tb/python/`; provide an equivalent.

Also: an independent reference model (not a copy of the RTL); random input gaps and output back-pressure on every stream; register readback; edge cases; a mutation check (break one rule, show the testbench fails).

Every simulation script names the tests it can run: `ip/scripts/run_sim.sh symbol_overlay --list-tests` prints them (and every run prints them at its start). Put each test in its own `test_<what>` task in `tb/tests/<name>_tests.sv`, listed with a one-line description in that file's header.

Tests of the reference design (the new design must provide at least these):

| Testbench | Test | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `symbol_overlay_tb` | `test_id_block` | ID "SOVL", VERSION ("d.dd") and DATE (BCD mm/dd/yyyy) at the base address, read only (SLVERR); the rest of the map from 0x10 |
| `symbol_overlay_tb` | `test_registers` | Reset CTRL / STATUS / FRAME_NUM; object, label and text registers read back |
| `symbol_overlay_tb` | `test_passthrough` | CTRL.ENABLE = 0: the output equals the input with gaps and back-pressure; STATUS counts the frames |
| `symbol_overlay_tb` | `test_commit` | A filled box written without COMMIT does not apply; COMMIT applies at the next frame start (STATUS[0] pending meanwhile); a COMMIT in the middle of a frame applies from the next one; CTRL.ENABLE is taken at every frame start |
| `symbol_overlay_tb` | `test_frame_number` | FRAME_NUM reads the current frame's number: one more each frame (carries), a write sets the next frame's |

Code coverage (`make cov`, `ip/scripts/run_cov.sh`): every target is 100 % by default. A target may be lowered only here, per metric, with the reason; every item left uncovered is listed with its justification (unreachable by design, tied-off parameter, ...).

| Metric | Target |
|--------|--------|
| Line (statement) | 100 % |
| Branch (if / case arms, ternaries) | 100 % |
| Expression / condition | 100 % |
| Toggle (every bit 0->1 and 1->0) | 100 % |
| FSM state and transition | 100 % |
| Functional (a cover point / cover property per requirement, mode and corner) | 100 % |
| Assertions (every SVA property exercised, none failing) | 100 % |

Pass criteria: `make -C video/symbol_overlay test` passes, every coverage target met, Verilator lint clean, `sv_format.py --check` clean, `make synth` passes.
